title: Create: Bigger Storage Updated to Create 6
description: This is an addon to Create: Bigger Storage that makes it compatible with Create 6. THIS DOES NOT USE ANY ORIGINAL ASSETS FROM DREAMS AND DESIRES!!
body:
**_⚠️ This mod does not use or redistribute any assets from Create: Bigger Storage. ⚠️_**

# Create: Bigger Storage to Create 6

**Create: Bigger Storage to Create 6** is a compatibility bridge designed to enable **Create v6.0.4 - v6.0.8** to function alongside **[Create: Bigger Storage](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-bigger-storage) v0.1b.Release**.  
Please note that support is currently limited to these specific versions.  
At this time, there are no plans to support future versions of _Create: Bigger Storage_.

> ⚠️ **Disclaimer:** This mod has not been tested extensively outside of its intended use case.  
> While it should function alongside most mods, compatibility is not guaranteed.

If you encounter any issues or conflicts, please report them via our  
[GitHub repository](https://github.com/Landscapes-Reimagined/Issues-and-Suggestions) or join the discussion on our [**Discord server**](https://discord.gg/quenZthXgy).

> ❌ This mod is not intended to work with or support other mods,  
> and we currently do not plan to create similar compatibility patches for additional mods, though we invite you to suggest them in our Discord server.
